spec_resolution: User authorized current goal plus preserved diagnosis; older standalone R specification was not found

free_generation.arrival: single atomic prompt-array /completion request, original index order
free_generation.admission: Every warmup/measured run equals the same-fixture B0 tokens exactly; internal repeatability also required

numeric.gate: All checkpoints present, same full all-sequence history/batch/physical ubatch/seq/position/worker profile; all finite, equal argmax, maxabs=0 and byte equality
numeric.trace: Previously built and hashed observers, original source and ABI identities retained; R changes only CPU Q4 policy

route.model: One fresh R-diagnostic h1 visit, warmup and measured; actual original Q4 body counter plus retained exact Q4 and Q6 counters
route.synthetic: One separate probe exercising phase0/1/2/3 and eligible/guarded nr; not model correctness

bounded_failure_control.when: Any residual numeric or free-generation mismatch
bounded_failure_control.policy: same first affected fixture under full Q4off, B0 oracle reused; optional all-request teacher forcing only for first unresolved checkpoint

normal_build: HINT ON, TRACE OFF; route/observer diagnostics explicitly separate
singleton_note: h1 request3 is diagnostic singleton (109 prompt tokens); single-short is original pool fixture (132), kept separately. Neither substitutes for atomic 8-request cohorts.
